name: smwmusic-touhou-chireiden-subterranean-animism-the-sealed-away-youkai-lost-place-remix
title: Touhou Chireiden ~ Subterranean Animism - The Sealed-Away Youkai ~ Lost Place (Remix)
description:
Did a remix of Yamame's theme, The Sealed-Away Youkai ~ Lost Place from Touhou 11. I hate spiders, but I like Yamame, so it's all good. Plus, she's got a banger theme song like 90% of Touhou characters that I wanted to do a remix of for quite a while.

This baby is great for [final] boss fights, chase / tense sequences, final areas, and underground stages.

Important:
- "Bonus End," Thunder, and Yoshi SFX are disabled.

There are also 2 customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. D# Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. D Minor (Custom Pitch)
